shared_elements: repeated figures aligned in a horizontal row
quadruped animal (small, in A; rams in B)
justification:
The only real correspondence is generic: both show human figures repeated along a horizontal register, with at least one quadruped present, and both are oriented in profile. Otherwise the content is wholly different 
A is dominated by schematic ships with rows of stroke-like crew marks and tiny stick figures, while B shows fully modelled, bearded men leading heavy horned rams in a procession, with naturalistic detailing of hair, garments and fleece.
